places.name: Kaer Sethorn
places.text: The broken keep of House Dunmarrow. Torren's company rests here, sorts its gear and counts its coin.

places.name: Sallow Crossing
places.text: A ford village where carters, peddlers and rumours meet. The market sells gear and sigils.

places.name: Old Watchtower
places.text: A fallen border tower. Someone hid a purse in the cellar long ago.

places.name: Roadwolf Camp
places.text: Hask Gravelteeth's raiders hold the road to Eldrimar from this palisade.
